population: Adults at elevated cardiovascular risk without diabetes, within trial eligibility.
intervention_comparator: More intensive versus standard systolic BP target strategies.
finding: In the selected trial population, intensive control reduced cardiovascular events and mortality, with higher rates of some serious adverse effects.
limitations: Not a universal target for all ages, diabetes, pregnancy or comorbidities. Current regional guidelines and monitoring matter.

correction.status: Erratum linked in original PubMed record; correction text not independently audited.

population: Adults with mild asthma in the trial.
intervention_comparator: As-needed budesonide-formoterol versus as-needed albuterol and maintenance-budesonide strategy.
finding: The as-needed combination reduced exacerbations compared with as-needed albuterol alone in the trial.
limitations: Not all inhaler combinations, ages, severities, devices or regulatory approvals are interchangeable. Industry and public funding disclosed by the article.

population: Adults with persistent insomnia in the trial.
design: Randomized trial with acute and maintenance treatment stages.
intervention_comparator: CBT alone or combined with zolpidem, followed by maintenance strategies.
finding: CBT showed benefit; the role of combined medication differed between treatment phases.
limitations: An individual older trial does not establish a universal medicine regimen or current guideline. Full risk-of-bias assessment remains pending.
